description: List the creator handle claims of the caller's organization, as the web app's Handles settings show them: the latest claim of each claimed profile, by platform and newest first, each with its id, handle, platform, status (in_review, approved, rejected, expired, or revoked), expiresAt, verifiedUntil (when an approved claim's verification ends, or null), and verificationCode while the claim is in review, otherwise null. The creator sends that code by direct message from the claimed profile. An approved claim is a verified handle. Needs a credential.
name: list_handle_claims
title: List handle claims
